content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the 30-day window, especially after recent spikes.
- Model tends to overreact to recent high prices, overshooting downward in the first few days after a spike.
- Model shows persistent lag in capturing true price movements, particularly in the 10–15 day range.
- Mean reversion is overemphasized, causing model to prematurely predict returns to low levels after short-term spikes.
- Model underestimates the magnitude of price rebounds following sharp declines, especially in the 20–30 day horizon.
- Model exhibits bias toward lower values in the final 5–10 days of the forecast window, suggesting it underweights recent volatility.
